segments.text: Ok so, this is the headless interrupts page in the CopilotKit docs, for Google Antigravity with React, and I've implemented it in my project.
My project, with the exact page and hook from the doc. App Surface isn't defined anywhere, so I added a small harness one.

And umm, nothing comes up. No reply, no time picker, and the surface still says no pending interrupt.
The hook waits for the old on interrupt event, so uh, it never sees Antigravity's interrupt.
So the chat just hangs, and you can never answer it.
Back on the doc. The browser page says not supported on Google Antigravity, but the markdown export still ships this code.
And the page renders App Surface, which is never defined, so as written it crashes.
